We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs. entries.description: Individual owner with 22 undeveloped acres in north central Pennsylvania, seeking people to develop the land in exchange for a long-term lease.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN STONE 124 Maplewood Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19144. I have 22 acres of land in north central PA. There is a spring site, but it needs to be developed. The land is ½ wooded and ½ clear. Electricity is available. There are no improvements to the property. I would be interested in having people develop the land in return for a long term lease. I welcome: letters. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 22 acres, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Listed under personal name, stored as community_name and contact_name. Contact address is in Philadelphia while land is in north central PA. num_residents is 0 because there are no improvements and the owner resides in Philadelphia. Type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule for an individual owner not yet on the land. Lesbian women coded from questionnaire context and '1 lesbian'. No focuses meet criteria.

entries.description: Community on 20 acres with 10 resident lesbians, aiming for self-sufficiency and hosting workshops, retreats, and rituals, welcoming new members/residents, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children on the second weekend of each month.
entries.raw_text: TURTLE LAND FOR WIMMIN 719 N Irving St, Arlington, VA 22201 (703)527-7396. Our goal is to create a diverse, fun, spiritually and politically conscious community living in harmony with nature and as self-sufficient as possible. Some retreats, workshops, music, rituals, etc. are going on already. A one room hexagon cabin should be finished by Summer '83. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children (only the 2nd weekend of each month), nonlesbian women who accept that men are not welcome and accept our lesbian identification, dogs. We have/are: 10 lesbians, 20 acres, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Mailing address is in Arlington, VA; land location is not stated so land fields are left blank. num_residents is 10 based on '10 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Type Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 10 lesbians living on the land and recruiting new members. Boy children welcome with restriction: 'only the 2nd weekend of each month'. Focuses coded: Spirituality/ritual ('spiritually and politically conscious community', 'rituals'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('as self-sufficient as possible'), and Workshops/education ('workshops... are going on already'). Lesbian separatism not coded because non-lesbian women are welcomed and separatism is not explicitly named.

entries.description: Individual owner of 50 acres in Pittsboro, NC, building a house and seeking to create a haven for older dykes, welcoming new members/residents and girl children.
entries.raw_text: DUFFY Z BAUM -PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340. I own 50 acres of land in Pittsboro, NC. I am building a house on the land and also have an old house on the land. I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer. I am anxious to have other women join me on my land. The land is quite isolated and has some nice big old trees. I'd like to be a haven for older dykes. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 50 acres, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land (questionable).

entries.description: Private land on 2.3 acres in Granville, OH with 2 resident lesbians starting an organic garden, open to short-term visitors, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and non-oppressive males (not overnight), with a substance-free rule.
entries.raw_text: ADLAI NEUBAUER & KAREN HAMM 3634 Loudon St, Granville, OH 43023 (614)587-4527. We are only beginning. We have a small piece of land and the start of an organic garden. We envision a community of women supporting each other emotionally, spiritually and financially through responsible collective work. Visitors should plan to stay a maximum of two nights unless a work exchange or other arrangements are made (2 week advance notice preferred). No drug addicts/alcoholics, kleptomaniacs, or other disrespectful people welcome. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, non oppressive males (not overnight), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2.3 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Listed under personal names, stored as community_name and contact_name. Street address treated as land address. num_residents is 2 based on '2 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule: 2 lesbians living on 2.3 acres; they envision a community but are not actively recruiting permanent members/residents to live there (visitors limited to two nights, 'new members/residents' not checked). Accepted groups: Gay men and Non-gay men coded with condition from 'non oppressive males (not overnight)'; Girl children, Boy children, Non-lesbian women explicitly welcomed; Lesbian women inferred. Focus Recovery/substance-free coded from 'No drug addicts/alcoholics... welcome'. Organic garden mention is not sufficient for Farming focus.

Older feminists especially encouraged to respond. We welcome written (or taped) inquiries and correspondence. No drop ins or surprise telephone requests for overnight accomodations. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children (only during July), nonlesbian women, older women especially welcome. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
